programs.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programs.desc: Follow traveling host He Tianran as he explores Xizang's many cultural treasures. Take in the majesty of the Potala Palace, discover intangible cultural heritage skills such as Tibetan paper making and Tibetan incense, and experience the plateau's natural wonders in a whole new light.

programs.title: The Blue World Ep.6
programs.desc: As China’s first panoramic marine documentary, this series brings coastal waters onto the cinematic stage. Combining breathtaking imagery with compelling narratives, it reveals the ecology, resources, and vibrant life existing within China’s mysterious blue frontiers.

programs.title: Journey of the Chili Pepper Ep.1
programs.desc: In China, the chili pepper is an indispensable winter ingredient. Since its arrival in the Ming dynasty, the spicy staple has been reshaping Chinese food culture. Today, as a new chili craze sweeps across the nation, we’ll take a look at how the chili evolved from a simple source of heat to a fiery cultural phenomenon.

programs.title: Razor: Traces of China Ep.3
programs.desc: Chinese elements can be found in many great European mansions, gardens and other public spaces. Join us as we look into these hidden features, motifs and designs and uncover a legacy of East-West cultural exchange that is all too often overlooked.
